loss of oxygen (or gain of electrons).

misconceptions.wrong: All metals are extracted by carbon.
Gold must be extracted from an ore.
misconceptions.right: Gold is unreactive and found as the metal itself.

infoPanels.title: EXTRACTION METHOD
infoPanels.secondaryContent: Above carbon → electrolysis. Below carbon → reduction by carbon.
